module: Flowgraph node "Custom UI Layout" (category provider): stores a UI apps layout in the node for reuse. Output "layout" (table layoutData: {apps, layoutName = 'procedural Layout <id>'}) to connect to Set UI Layout. Properties: Capture (reads the current layout via 'getCurrentLayoutToLua'), Clear, Load Stored Layout, Load Freeroam layout.
notes: The "Copy Layout from..." list is empty (layouts = {} , call to ui_apps.getLayouts commented out).
setLayout is called by the UI via getCmd(), which returns a function name without parentheses (command that receives the data from the UI).

drawCustomProperties.desc: Capture, Clear, Load Stored Layout, Load Freeroam layout buttons and copy list.

getCmd.desc: Returns the string of this node's Lua callback function (setLayout).

action.desc: Name of the activated button or output pin.

setLayout.desc: Receives the layout captured by the UI and stores data.apps in storedLayout.

uniqueId.desc: Returns "<idManager>_<nodeId>", used to name the temporary game state.
